name: smwsprites-pokey-heading-yoshi-s-island-pokey
title: Pokey Heading (Yoshi's Island Pokey)
description:
This is an enemy from Yoshi's Island that was always really funny.
The Needlenose that it spawns can be defeated by thrown objects or eaten by Yoshi, which will make the Pokey really sad.
The Pokey itself is mostly-invulnerable, only able to die from a star powered player, explosions, and lava.

There are 5 varieties available by default, accessible via Extra Byte 1;
- Green: Original behavior.
- Yellow: Launches the Needlenose at a consistent height.
- Red: Launches the Needlenose at much lower heights.
- Blue: Same behavior as the green variant, but its Needlenose never regrows, so it stays sad forever.
- Gray: The last bounce of its pattern will make the Needlenose explode.
More varieties with different patterns can be added from the ASM file.

Extra Byte 2 will delay its initial bounce of the Needlenose, allowing you to fine-tune it.

This sprite has also been uploaded on my Patreon, available here.
